top.line: Fliplet, a rented AI software builder, against the website cell, a one-off build the owner keeps.

in-short.line: Prompt-built and AI-changed; rented in credits; its terms keep the application; the cell inverts it.

sign.line: Building software from a description is going mainstream; the question is who owns the result.

fliplet.line: Prompt to draft to review; reviews, roles, data centres; 34,000 organisations claimed.

rent.line: Free to $200 a month in credits for AI, hosting and traffic; custom domains from $25.

cell.line: Same core; paid once, owned in your repository, portable, no subscription, open.

terms.line: Every site moves into its owner's ownership within three months at the latest.

limits.line: Fliplet from its pages and standard terms; different products; the promise a soft requirement.

sources.line: fliplet.com and its pricing, and earlier articles.

ownership.line: Its terms: the service and what you build are Fliplet's; a licence; no transfer, no code, no copy on termination.
ownership.para: Your own domain on paid plans.
